findings: AI crawlers are allowed by robots.txt.
No /llms.txt — AI engines have no curated map of your key pages.
fixes: Publish /llms.txt: a markdown index of your most important pages (products, about, FAQ, policies) with 1-line descriptions. This is one of the highest-leverage low-effort AEO wins.
